Posterior-mean cumulative thresholds of a brms cumulative fit

Source: R/ordinal_engine.R
maihda_brms_ordinal_thresholds.Rd

The brms analogue of clmm's object$model$alpha: the ordered cut points \(\alpha_k\) of a brms::cumulative() fit, read as posterior means from brms::fixef(), where they appear as Intercept[1], Intercept[2], ... (any location predictors are separate rows and are dropped here). Returned in threshold order so they pair with the brms::posterior_linpred(re_formula = NA) location – which excludes the thresholds, exactly the latent \(\eta\) that maihda_ordinal_category_probs expects (\(P(Y \le k) = g^{-1}(\alpha_k - \eta)\)).

Usage

maihda_brms_ordinal_thresholds(model)

Arguments

model

A fitted brmsfit from brms::cumulative().

Value

A numeric vector of thresholds (length \(K-1\) for \(K\) categories).
